_comment: EC2 Recommended IAM Policy — attach to your EC2 IAM Role (e.g. CloudWatch-Monitoring)
_use_case: Method 5 and Method 6: EC2 instance tag-based secret retrieval

3. Paste this policy (remove the _comment fields first)
